inv.desc_en:
Fantastic commercial premises with two floors, located at Valencia street number 116 with Viladomat street, it has a constructed area of 161 m2, a building from 2008.

Lower floor consists of a 61m2 constructed area, entrance with a large window, reception, meeting room, a toilet.

Upper floor built area of 109m2, distributor, independent office, two spacious rooms, office, toilet.

Renovated, excellent finishes, parquet flooring, fitted wardrobes, hot/cold air conditioning.

Commercial area, smoke outlet, very well connected by buses and metro L1 "Rocafort" and L5 "Hospital Clinic".
